text:
Tess - CSM: Cobalt Labs asked for cost-reduction options before renewal. Traffic is very chatty: median 24 tokens, heavy p95 spikes during peak. Can we propose a low-risk pilot?

Ravi - ML Eng: Recommend short-path quant (int8 or int4) for <=48 tokens and keep long requests on current model. Start tiny: 2-3% canary and run regression on their canonical prompts.

Ola - SuccessOps: Add prefix caching for repeated confirmations and a watchlist of 30 critical prompts. Acceptance: >=12% cost savings OR p95 improvement >=15% with <=1% quality regression.

Marco - SRE: Guard rails: only run canary during 10:00-16:00 local, rollback if error_rate >0.5% or numeric regressions detected. Also create an alert channel for the customer SREs.

Ravi - ML Eng: Quick config snippet for dry-run:

```
route_policy:
  - match: "request.tokens <= 48 && rand() < 0.03"
    model: gpt-compact-int8-v2
    fallback: gpt-compact-fp16-v1
slo_guards:
  p95_ms: 600
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
monitoring: sample_quality: 500
```

canary-bot: canary workspace created /canaries/3521112223-preview (dry-run).

Tess - CSM: I'll loop in Cobalt Labs for an opt-in window. Action items: Ravi -> regression report; Ola -> one-pager + watchlist; Marco -> alerts + dry-run. Will update thread after their confirmation. :white_check_mark:
